assessments.mechanism: Scale effective independent information channels/diversity rather than raw homogeneous agent count.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026 MAS reasoning evidence; reported 2-diverse-vs-16-homogeneous result is configuration-specific, not a universal ratio.
assessments.uncertainty: O has not measured effective-channel diversity under a matched MAS budget.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly detects method-family concentration and mandates materially heterogeneous search, so the principle is known.

assessments.mechanism: Route tasks to MAS topologies based on decomposability, sequentiality, tool intensity and baseline capability.
assessments.clean_scope: Controlled 260-configuration study across six benchmarks with topology effects ranging strongly positive to strongly negative.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer outside those model/task/topology cells remains open.
assessments.o_comparison: No MAS topology selector or topology-task matching evaluation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Autonomous asynchronous multi-agent co-evolution with persistent knowledge and local verification.
assessments.clean_scope: CORAL open-ended optimization; shared memory is part of the tested mechanism and may conflict with strict independent-exploration settings.
assessments.uncertainty: Causal contribution of shared memory/population structure is not isolated for O-like work.
assessments.o_comparison: O has isolated parallel work, durable evidence and local verification primitives but no autonomous co-evolving population/shared-memory system.

assessments.mechanism: Quality-diversity/niching for LLM-assisted evolutionary search with adaptive niche granularity.
assessments.clean_scope: PartEvo on four automated algorithm-discovery benchmarks; reported K=4 at N=16 is empirical/non-universal.
assessments.uncertainty: Descriptor/niche design and transfer remain unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: No MAP-Elites/niching/QD archive mechanism or matched niche-granularity experiment was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Evolve the multi-agent configuration itself, with reusable configuration pools plus experience memory.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoMAS on BBEH/WorkBench/SWE-Bench family; some rewards use LLM-as-judge.
assessments.uncertainty: Judge dependence and transfer outside benchmark configurations remain material.
assessments.o_comparison: O evolves/scopes Candidates but not MAS role/model/tool topology populations; no EvoMAS-like configuration-pool experiment exists.

assessments.mechanism: Adaptive per-query pruning of both agent count and communication topology.
assessments.clean_scope: AGP/ECAI 2025, mostly text benchmarks and gpt-4o-mini. Reported +2.58% to +9.84% task improvement and >90% token reduction in strongest comparisons; full MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval 87.65/95.01/90.62 versus no-soft 83.49/90.13/85.63 and no-hard 85.20/91.56/88.41.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer to long-horizon tool/embodied agents is unestablished.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no MAS node/edge pruning controller or dynamic team-size/topology evaluation.

assessments.mechanism: Choose outer search strategy conditionally on search-landscape properties; QD is not universally superior to greedy/islands/etc.
assessments.clean_scope: Heuresis 2026, three ML-research domains, 300 executed ideas per strategy/domain (5,400 executions; 3,222 scored). Greedy best on nanoGPT/unlearning while MAP-Elites best on one RL landscape; Asterix held-out Islands 3.991±0.041 vs MAP-Elites 2.755±0.186. 0/3,222 ideas rated fully Original.
assessments.uncertainty: Prompts/strategies were intentionally untuned and landscape descriptors are not yet a validated selector.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly requires strategy review/change under repeated failure or method-family concentration and does not assume one search family dominates; no direct Heuresis landscape-selector evaluation exists.

assessments.mechanism: Learn dynamic role+edge dropout to optimize an accuracy-token frontier instead of maximizing nominal team size.
assessments.clean_scope: AgentDropout ACL 2025. Average prompt/completion reductions 21.6%/18.4% with +1.14 task performance; Llama3 full two-stage node+edge 68.70 versus vanilla MAS 65.72. Dropout 0.2 gives 68.70 at 3.3M/839K prompt/completion tokens while 0.8 gives 66.01 at 856K/230K.
assessments.uncertainty: Task/model transfer and training cost of dropout policy remain bounded.
assessments.o_comparison: No learned MAS node/edge dropout or pruning-intensity controller was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Preserve diversity in adversarial program evolution and retain opponent/test history to reduce specialist overfit/cycles.
assessments.clean_scope: Digital Red Queen 2026. Static specialists collectively defeat/tie 283/294 human warriors (96.3%) yet one specialist averages only 27.9%; K=1→10 opponent history reduces three-warrior cyclic dynamics by 77%. MAP-Elites ablation is qualitative in accessible primary page.
assessments.uncertainty: Core War scope and missing numeric MAP-Elites ablation limit causal generalization.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no QD/adversary-population archive or matched historical-opponent robustness mechanism.

assessments.mechanism: Heterogeneous mutation/model lineages can outperform homogeneous parallelism at fixed total LLM-call budget.
assessments.clean_scope: DEI 2026 Core War. Four-model heterogeneous ensemble merged QD score 45.90 vs single-node 20.46 (+124%) with coverage 80.6% vs 63.0%; homogeneous merged QD score 29.85/coverage 59.0.
assessments.uncertainty: Model-family heterogeneity is not decomposed from cheaper prompt/role/tool/sampling diversity; Core War only.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly seeks materially heterogeneous methods/providers/tool routes when concentration is detected, so the principle is known; no fixed-budget DEI/QD experiment exists.

assessments.mechanism: Model heterogeneity helps mainly when interaction structure leaves room for complementary priors; prompt-tone/persona diversity is much weaker and raw N saturates.
assessments.clean_scope: Findings ACL 2026 across 20 ICLR topics. N=3→7 Vendi 3.09→3.32 (+7.4%) while Vendi/N 1.03→0.47. Heterogeneous models under authority-weighted topology +34.0% Vendi (p=.0003,d=2.33) but horizontal -4.1% (p=.627); prompt-tone eta² .023.
assessments.uncertainty: Ideation/research-proposal scope; heterogeneous condition is not a complete model×prompt×tool factorial.
assessments.o_comparison: O already treats heterogeneity as conditional on concentration/decision value rather than a universal multiplier; no MAS diversity/coupling measurement is implemented.
